title: What does subtracting a negative mean?
text: Subtracting a number means adding its opposite. The opposite of $$-5$$ is positive 5, so this is not the same as $$-12 - 5$$. A common mistake is to move further left and answer $$-17$$. Subtracting $$-5$$ is the same as which operation?

title: Rewrite, then add
text: The expression is now $$-12 + 5$$. The signs are opposite and 12 is larger, so the result stays negative. The distance that remains is $$12 - 5$$. What is $$12 - 5$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$-12 - (-5) = -12 + 5 = -7$$. Common mistake: $$ -12 - 5 = -17 $$, which subtracts a positive instead of a negative. General rule: $$a - (-b) = a + b$$. Subtracting a negative moves you in the positive direction.
